headline: MIA @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 3.31 at TOR 3.36, with a projected total of 6.67. The cold/risk list flags Myles Straw, Kazuma Okamoto because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
